title: Q4
description:
“He has not put the world to come, of which we speak, in subjection to angels.”
Read: Deut 32:8 (compare the Greek reading “according to the number of the angels of God”), Dan 10:13, 20–21, Psa 8:6
a) Some OT texts picture the nations of this age assigned to heavenly rulers. What does that background bring forward when Hebrews says the *world to come* is not given to angels but, by Psa 8, to man?
